spans.s: Naishāda, adj. (pl. said about the practices of the Nishādas). § 643b (Kāyavyacarita): XII, 135, 4855 (ºānāṃ kovidaḥ, sc. Kāyavya).
Naishadha, pl. (ºāḥ), a people = Nishadha, pl. § 347 (Nalopākhyānap.): III, 61, 2315; 64, 2413 (ºānāṃ janādhipa, i.e. Nala).
Naishadha^2, the king of the Nishadhas at the time of Yudhishṭhira. § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 20, 804 (in Droṇa's gāruḍavyūha); 32, 1437 (Bṛhatkshattraṃ ca Nºaṃ, slain by Dhṛshṭadyumna).
Naishadhya, adj. (“originating from the Nishadhas”). § 552 (Goharaṇap.): IV, 42, 1338 (sc. khaḍgaḥ).
Naishādi^1 (“prince of the Nishādas”) = Ekalavya: I, 5242, 5248, 5260, 5268; VII, 8214, 8229, 8230.
Naishādi^5 (do.), a Kuru warrior. § 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 60, 3055 (slain by Bhīmasena).
